# Haki Realm

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/hakirework.png)

</div>

Awaken Haki, build a mastery tree, train under a school master and earn Conqueror’s Haki.

Installed build `2.0.0-1.20.1`. [Browse all mods](index.md).
